risk_paths.description: Starting in PostgreSQL 14, regular expressions that use \w as a range start or end inside a character class (e.g. [\w-z]) are disallowed. Previously they were accepted but produced unexpected results; such patterns will now raise errors when evaluated.

conditions.statement: The upgrade crosses PostgreSQL release 14 (13 -> 16), where \w as a range endpoint in character classes became disallowed.
